titulo: UK accuses Israeli ‘terrorists’ of ethnic cleansing in West Bank with government backing
cuerpo: Ed Miliband announces sanctions on trade with settlements as PM says in the Guardian it is time to act I believe in a two-state solution in the Middle East. That’s why we’re taking action to keep that hope alive | Andy Burnham Settler terrorists supported by Benjamin Netanyahu’s government are committing ethnic cleansing in the West Bank, Ed Miliband has said, in the UK’s starkest condemnation since the foundation of the Israeli state. Andy Burnham, the prime minister, said he would “not stand by” as horrific suffering continued, writing in the Guardian that for too long the UK had been hesitant to act , “fearful of being accused of being anti-Israel”. An import ban on goods from illegal settlements in the occupied territories and a new ban for arms licences and other exports that “materially contribute to the occupation”. A comprehensive sanctions regime against providing services such as construction or financing for Israeli settlements and a ban on advertising them in the UK.
